
Name:
  jf rt upload - Uploads files.

Usage:
  jf rt upload [command options] <source pattern> <target pattern>

Arguments:
  source pattern
    The local files to upload.

  target pattern
    The repository path to upload to.

Options:
  --archive       [Optional] Packs the files into an archive before uploading.
  --build-name    [Optional] The build the files belong to.
  --explode       [Default: false] Extracts an uploaded archive on the server.
  --flat          [Default: false] Drops the local directory structure.
  --recursive     [Default: true] Includes sub-directories.
  --regexp        [Default: false] Reads the source pattern as a regular expression.
  --spec          [Optional] A file that lists what to upload.
  --sync-deletes  [Optional] Removes server files that no longer exist locally.
  --target-props  [Optional] Properties to set on the uploaded files.
